deltas.proposed_change: Make Qwen3.5's native vision/mmproj representation the first-choice shared deep visual representation for both MVC and semantic escalation; keep a dedicated lightweight embedding encoder only as a matched counterbaseline/fallback until evidence decides.
deltas.strongest_counterhypothesis: A dedicated lightweight embedding encoder materially dominates raw/projected Qwen features for instance/layout familiarity and unknown rejection under equal total resource budget.
deltas.rollback: Retain current dedicated-feature MVC baseline and do not delete its implementation path before H1/H2/H3 evidence.

deltas.proposed_change: Add optional text/name anchor binding to GOLD-labeled visual prototypes so user-named entities can exploit native multimodal representation geometry without turning names or model semantics into sensor truth.
deltas.strongest_counterhypothesis: Text semantic similarity contaminates instance identity and increases false familiarity.
deltas.rollback: Disable text-anchor contribution and preserve visual-only prototypes.

deltas.proposed_change: Use a hierarchical visual-change controller: deterministic pixel/tile change gate -> Qwen feature-space semantic-delta estimate -> full semantic 4B decode only when uncertainty/novelty/conflict/task criticality warrants it -> GWT only when globally useful.
deltas.strongest_counterhypothesis: Feature distance is not calibrated enough to safely gate semantic decode, especially for small text or subtle state changes.
deltas.rollback: Use deterministic change gate plus direct semantic decode escalation without feature-distance gating.

deltas.proposed_change: Bind every MVC/prototype/cache artifact to exact model, vision/mmproj, quantization, pooling/projection and runtime-version identity; reject stale feature spaces by default and require explicit migration/rebuild.
deltas.strongest_counterhypothesis: The extra version boundary adds state/maintenance complexity without material protection because representations remain sufficiently compatible across deployed updates.
deltas.rollback: Keep simpler current feature-backbone version invalidation semantics if stronger version granularity proves unnecessary.

promotion_rule: No delta promotes from narrative or generic benchmark evidence. Require matched Frank fixtures, resource shadows, open-set/action correctness, replay/recovery and no simpler dominating baseline.
